remarks:
Welcome to 14 Glen Burn Trail, your new home away from home! Currently being used as a Vacation home AND a short-term rental. Built in 2013, this center showcase unit is located just a short drive from Holiday Valley, and minutes away from all the charming shops, restaurants, and conveniences of the Village of Ellicottville. The home is completely move-in ready, and is being sold furnished, so all you need are the keys! 
Enter the foyer, with warm natural woodwork, heated tile floors and into the modern chef's kitchen with stainless steel appliances, plenty of soft close cabinetry, granite countertops, and a large island with a breakfast bar. The open concept living/dining/kitchen area is perfect for entertaining and spending quality time with loved ones. The gas fireplace in the living room will keep you cozy during ski season, and the sliding glass door leads you out to the patio with a fire pit and gas grill to enjoy the other three seasons. Powder room completes the first floor. Upstairs you will find 3 generously sized bedrooms with large closets. The den is a bonus space for relaxing, complete with a sleeper sofa and television. Two full bathrooms are on this level, with one en suite to the primary bedroom with tiled walk-in shower. Out front you will find an exterior Ski Locker for added storage. RECENT PRICE IMPROVMENT.
